english_outline:
1. Main conclusion: Reuters reports Nvidia guided Q3 FY2027 revenue to $108B, above LSEG consensus of $104.19B, and forecast 70% revenue growth for FY2028, far above the 44% analyst average. AP reports strong AI chip demand drove Q2 results well beyond Wall Street expectations.
2. Core business change: Data Center revenue reached $89.0B, up 117% YoY, beating LSEG estimate of $85.08B. Vera Rubin platform started shipping and will account for about one-fifth of data center revenue in Q3. Neo-clouds will exit the year with over 8 GW of Nvidia GPU capacity, up from 3 GW. AWS will deploy 2 million additional Nvidia GPUs in 2027-2028.
3. Impact on growth, margin, cash flow expectations: Revenue growth is accelerating but supply-constrained, especially memory components. CFO Colette Kress said margins will bottom in Q4 at roughly 71%-72%, down from about 74% in Q3, due to soaring memory prices and higher component costs. Q3 gross margin guidance is 74.0% ±50bp. China data center revenue is excluded from guidance.
4. Market pricing and institutional views: Shares rose nearly 5% in extended trading after initially dipping over 1%. Futurum Equities' Shay Boloor said demand broadening beyond hyperscalers makes the forecast more credible. Analysts on average projected 44% revenue growth for FY2028, versus Nvidia's 70% forecast.
5. Next-quarter verification point: Whether Vera Rubin reaches about one-fifth of data center revenue, whether memory supply constraints ease, and whether China data center revenue materializes.
reader_questions: 稿件称第三财季毛利率指引为74.0%，但路透社报道CFO称毛利率将在第四财季触底于约71%至72%、低于第三财季的约74%。这两个数字是否指向同一口径？稿件是否把不同季度的毛利率混为一谈？
稿件称公司给出下一财年营收增长约70%的预测，但官方新闻稿的指引部分只列出第三财季营收1080亿美元及全年税率区间，并未出现70%这一数字。70%来自何处？是否应明确标注为电话会/路透社口径而非官方指引？
稿件称Vera Rubin平台在截至10月的财季将贡献数据中心营收约五分之一，但官方新闻稿只说该平台已进入满产、合作伙伴正在运行机架，未给出占比。这一占比是否仅见于路透社报道？稿件是否应区分官方披露与媒体转述？
checks: 核查：官方新闻稿第三财季指引为营收1080亿美元±2%、GAAP与非GAAP毛利率均为74.0%±50个基点；路透社报道CFO称毛利率将在第四财季触底于约71%至72%，低于第三财季的约74%。两者口径不同：官方74.0%是第三财季指引，71%—72%是第四财季触底预期。原稿将两者并列而未说明季度差异，易造成混淆，需在修订稿中明确区分。
核查：官方新闻稿未出现“70%”这一下一财年增长预测，该数字仅见于路透社报道（公司预测下一财年营收增长70%，分析师平均预期44%）。因此修订稿须将该预测标注为路透社报道/电话会口径，不能表述为官方指引。
核查：官方新闻稿仅称Vera Rubin已进入满产、合作伙伴包括CoreWeave、Google Cloud、Microsoft Azure、Oracle Cloud Infrastructure和Nebius正在运行机架，未给出占数据中心营收比例。约五分之一占比仅见于路透社报道，修订稿须标注来源。
